description: List a book's figures — images the text references, identified by caption (Figure 1-2 / Рис. 3.1) — with page + caption per figure, then fetch chosen ones as images via indexes (≤3 per call). Captions let you pick figures before spending image tokens. In MCP Apps hosts the fetched figures also render for the user in an in-chat viewer, so you can point at them by figure number — but describe only what the pixels you received actually show.

detail.description: Image resolution: standard ≤1024px longest side (default), high ≤1568px.

format.description: Source format override (epub or pdf). Default: epub if present, else pdf.

include_uncaptioned.description: Also list/fetch images with no caption (covers, decorations, equation images).

indexes.description: Figure indexes from a previous list call — returns those figures as images (≤3 per call). Omit to list. Indexes are per-format; re-list after changing format.

name: calibre_get_figures
title: Get book figures
